name: Historic Town of St George and Related Fortifications, Bermuda
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: St George's, on the northeastern tip of Bermuda, is the oldest surviving English town in the New World, founded in 1612 and capital of the island until 1815. Its narrow lanes hold St. Peter's Church, the State House and the Unfinished Church. Around the harbour, forts, batteries and magazines built between 1612 and 1939 show how defences changed as cannon grew more powerful.
